crossRefs.note: “This is the thing that you shall do to them to make them holy, to minister to me in the priest’s office: take one…
You shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother, for glory and for beauty.
“You shall make tunics for Aaron’s sons. You shall make sashes for them. You shall make headbands for them, for glory…
Of the blue, purple, and scarlet, they made finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, and made the holy…
the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments…
“Also take fine spices: of liquid myrrh, five hundred shekels; and of fragrant cinnamon half as much, even two hundred…
“You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shall wash them with water.
“This is the thing that you shall do to them to make them holy, to minister to me in the priest’s office: take one…
unleavened bread, unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil. You shall make them of fine…
who doesn’t need, like those high priests, to offer up sacrifices daily, first for his own sins, and then for the sins…

parallels.note: You shall put them into one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the bull and the two rams.

people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

translations.web: “Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and the bull of the sin offering, and the two rams, and the basket of unleavened bread;
